svg.text: Traffic Jam: real 12-dose cascade replay (6.85U over 335min, real SMB log)
Pool Compartment: max gap vs conventional = 0.941U (13.7%) at t=196min. TsunamiMods: max gap = 0.557U (8.1%) at t=184min.

tick marks = real SMB dose events. Both forks' own crowding mechanisms are reproduced (Pool Compartment's pooled-mass k1, TsunamiMods' pooled-SC time-warp). Shaded area = Pool Compartment's own depot-stage mass, the part of IOB driving crowding.
